evidence.observation: Debt schedule identifiers and category rows begin with Debt Securities, including bundle none examples such as Debt Securities Aerospace & Defense.
Debt identifiers include explicit Maturity Date followed by an mm/dd/yy date.
Debt identifiers include a leading stated coupon after the instrument name.
Debt identifiers include SOFR plus spread in parentheses; other rows include PRIME plus spread.
Equity schedule identifiers begin with Equity Securities and generally do not carry debt rate or maturity terms.

notes: Debt and equity section anchors give category identifiers a signature; rate grammar remains scoped to rows with embedded rate/reference/maturity datapoints.
